title: Payments ops user blocked from Outlook: AADSTS53000 on a non-compliant laptop
narrative: Emery reports Outlook keeps asking to sign in and then shows 'You can't get there from here'. The sign-in log shows AADSTS53000 from CA004. Intune shows NWL-LT-0506 still on Windows 10 22H2 with BitLocker off, non-compliant since 20 Oct (well past the 24h grace). An Intune reporting-delay advisory is active but does not explain the real setting violations.

auditEvidence.source: Service desk ticket: BitLocker enabled, feature update scheduled (synthetic)
